 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. Köln face Union Berlin in the first of their two head-to-head games this week. The hosts drew with Schalke in the weekend, while Union Berlin held Augsburg despite playing more than half of the game with a player less.
 Here are the lineups for the duel at RheinEnergieStadion.
